title: WarioWare, Inc. - Mega Microgames!
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 802 (addresses converted to GBA bus addresses)
gbaverify boot sweep: game-over screen: microgames cleared 3 = the HUD's 003
European AZWP: lives and score 0x10 higher (0x030039E5, 0x030039EC: the EU ROM's literal pools; seen changing in a running game); region = the header code's last letter (0x080000AF, 'P' = 0x50)

Stage records: 8 bytes each from 0x02000020 (status u8: 0 locked, 2 unlocked, 3 cleared; Top 1-3 u16 at +2/+4/+6), in the order Intro, Jimmy, 9-Volt, Dribble, Kat, Mona, Dr. Crygor, Orbulon, Wario, Remix 1, Remix 2, Easy, Thrilling, Hard, Total Boss: each record given its own Top 1 in emulated EWRAM and read back from the game's stage menu (EU and US ROMs)

widgets.text:
Microgames last a few seconds each; 4 lives
Speed rises; a boss stage every few games
Score = microgames cleared
Each stage belongs to one character with its own microgame theme

rows: Wario, Jimmy T., Mona, Dribble & Spitz, 9-Volt (Nintendo classics), Dr. Crygor, Orbulon, Kat & Ana

widgets.text:
Boss microgames are longer and must be cleared to finish a stage
The prompt word tells the goal: "Dodge!", "Catch!", "Shoot!"

Each character's stage = 1 genre of microgames
Remix stages mix all genres
Grid of unlocked stages on the menu
Toys and minigames unlocked by high scores: Paper Plane, Pyoro, Dr. Wario, etc.

200+ microgames; each played once gets added to the Grid
Play any microgame alone from the Grid to beat its record

Clear all characters, then the final remix
Hit the high-score target per stage for each unlock
